custodyProfile.uncertainty: Immediate assets are held in on-chain vault and lender-position contracts; borrower collateral and upstream stablecoin reserve custody are separate exposures. No exact-share legal insolvency priority or whole-book off-chain collateral-custody safeguards were established. Lending reuse is explicit. June 2026 Sentora terms section 4.3 describes non-custodial vault configurations; section 21.4 specifies BVI governing law and arbitration. This is an issuer legal statement, not evidence of borrower collateral segregation or removal of observed curator powers. Underlying mWIN disclosures conflict. Sentora describes mWIN transfers as permissionless, while the Midas/Aave material and LlamaRisk review describe transfer allowlisting; underlying mWIN transfer eligibility remains unresolved and is distinct from the vault share's observed permissionless transfers. Vault Street's custody description denies custody use/reuse rights, while LlamaRisk quotes terms permitting omnibus use, cash commingling and a custodian lien. No no-reuse, segregation or unencumbered-custody conclusion is established from these conflicting descriptions. Lending deployment is intentional strategy reuse; it does not establish custodians' contractual rights to repledge collateral, which remain unknown.
